behavior: Upload a body image, choose the target region, add a transparent design and manipulate it on a locked photo; show fit, mask and calibration controls beside the result.
boundary: Preserve the original photo; label manual/assisted fit and uncalibrated size.
acceptance: Save and reopen two placements with identical orientation, scale, masks and source revision.

behavior: Propose a region surface/warp, preview control mesh and allow anchor correction; update projection as the user changes design orientation, including wrap-around layouts.
boundary: A planar transform is not sufficient for arbitrary curved skin; flag unsupported/unseen surfaces and self-intersections.
acceptance: A sleeve fixture stays continuous across supported views and seams; anchor edits change geometry rather than only overlay position.

behavior: Choose original lighting or named light rigs; adjust direction, strength, warmth and contrast with original/preview comparison and saved settings.
boundary: Camera exposure and material assumptions remain visible; avoid modifying the source artwork palette silently.
acceptance: Switching light presets alters shading consistently while preserving design shape, selected ink values and repeatable scenario parameters.

behavior: Select camera/body region, acquire tracking, attach placement, show confidence, lock/unlock, pause for editing and capture; retain full shared tool access.
boundary: Denial, unsupported camera, occlusion and track loss produce recoverable states; remote processing requires consent.
acceptance: Camera denial recovers to photo/avatar; controlled motion and occlusion meet the supported-device tracking gate without floating artwork.

behavior: Record or import video, trim a range, track the chosen region, inspect frame failures, correct keyframes, compare versions and export a timestamped clip.
boundary: Detect scene cuts and variable frame rate; unsupported frames remain marked, not interpolated as reliable observations.
acceptance: A clip with occlusion/cut retains edits and timestamps; exporting and reopening never applies a later-frame correction to the wrong frame.

behavior: Display tattoo colors over a diverse skin reference set using explicit blend/material parameters; keep selected ink palette separate from display adaptation.
boundary: Do not infer ethnicity or claim calibrated real-ink response from a screen preview.
acceptance: Review color/contrast preservation across consented skin-tone and lighting fixtures; record per-group failure rates and uncertainty.

behavior: Read decoded pixel dimensions, orientation, profile and alpha; create optimized preview assets while retaining original resolution and aspect ratio.
boundary: Normalization changes working representation, not silently the requested physical tattoo size.
acceptance: Portrait EXIF images, huge transparent PNGs and mixed-DPI imports retain correct orientation, proportions and source originals.

behavior: Inspect transparency on upload; run chosen remover when needed; show checkerboard and body preview with add/subtract mask refinement and restore original.
boundary: Preserve intentional white ink and partial alpha; never treat a PNG extension or success toast as proof of removal.
acceptance: White-background JPEG, white-ink PNG and feathered strokes export with correct alpha and survive re-import.

behavior: Select a component by click, box, brush or optional description; refine/invert/feather its mask, recolor or move it into an independent layer.
boundary: Model output is an editable proposal; show no-result/ambiguous selection and preserve all unselected art.
acceptance: Select one petal in a multicolor design, recolor only that petal, undo, save and reopen with the mask intact.

behavior: Save the editable document and independently capture current-view image/video with resolution, background and privacy options; show local/cloud status.
boundary: Screenshot/export and editable Save are distinct; quota/offline failures never erase the active document.
acceptance: Capture excludes handles/tool overlays; reopen retains editable objects and placements after interrupted synchronization.

behavior: Open the same project on a generic or personal avatar, orbit/pan/zoom, choose body side and pose, place and edit artwork directly on its surface.
boundary: Keep camera navigation distinct from placement transforms; unavailable model/texture assets have retry/fallback.
acceptance: Orbiting changes the view only; modifying design updates the avatar while source layers remain editable.

behavior: Compare registered photos or synchronized avatar cameras showing one placement; annotate occluded/unmatched regions and save camera presets.
boundary: Independent unregistered photos cannot be represented as a verified common coordinate system.
acceptance: A selected motif retains region/side across views; an unmatched photo is visibly excluded from confident fit comparisons.

behavior: Create reversible skin-display scenarios for texture, hair/scars/stretch marks and tanning/paleness; show original beside the scenario.
boundary: Scenarios illustrate appearance, not predict biological change; do not alter saved personal identity attributes automatically.
acceptance: Reset restores the original image/skin material; scenario exports include changed parameters and illustrative label.

behavior: Enter physical dimensions or calibrate against a known reference, compare sizes/common objects and print a scale ruler; keep mm/inch conversion visible.
boundary: Reference perspective and uncertainty must be recorded; no known scale means no precise physical claim.
acceptance: Round-trip unit conversion and exact-size export preserve dimensions; missing calibration produces a visible unresolved field.

behavior: Toggle an educational region heat map, inspect sources/variation and record personal notes or practitioner advice separately.
boundary: No personal pain score inferred as fact; release only with reviewed content and limits.
acceptance: Legend explains variability; disabling the map removes it from exports and never changes placement or booking eligibility.

behavior: Show skin and ink masks separately; adjust feathering, spill suppression and occlusion boundaries using a zoomed edge preview.
boundary: Avoid deleting fine linework or clipping foreground white ink to remove a background.
acceptance: Hair/skin edge and fine-line fixtures retain intended foreground while suppressing outside-region ink; undo restores mask.

behavior: Select a pose/movement sequence, scrub or play, inspect stretch/compression and compare neutral pose with movement.
boundary: Rig simulation is illustrative unless fitted to validated personal motion; flag severe distortion.
acceptance: Joint-flex sequence retains placement identity and shows distortion/seam warnings; source art remains unchanged.

behavior: Provide editable height/proportion/limb/circumference controls, region presets, neutral view and texture choices; allow custom rather than only stereotyped bodies.
boundary: Label the result as generalized; do not infer exact geometry from weight alone.
acceptance: Extreme supported proportions retain valid mesh and placement; changing shape prompts whether physical size or relative coverage should be preserved.

behavior: Guided region capture checks overlap, blur, lighting and coverage; reconstruct asynchronously, review defects and explicitly accept a retargeted version.
boundary: Scans can fail; preserve previous target. Separate measured surfaces from inferred holes and require consent for processing.
acceptance: A known measured object/body-region fixture passes scale/seam tests; poor capture is rejected with actionable recapture guidance.

behavior: Import or generate an eligible compatible target through an isolated adapter; map anatomy/UVs and preserve project placements on reviewed retargeting.
boundary: Licensing, runtime size and accurate personal fit are separate gates; photorealism alone is insufficient.
acceptance: Representative project opens on both base avatar and candidate model with measured placement differences and documented unsupported regions.

behavior: Maintain versioned region/side UV maps linked to 3D targets, editable source textures, seam markers and placement anchors.
boundary: Retarget new topology explicitly; one UV convention is not universal compatibility.
acceptance: Known landmarks map 2D→3D→2D within tolerance; seam-crossing artwork remains continuous on supported models.

behavior: Offer named illustrative aging scenarios with editable assumptions, preserved original, side-by-side views and saved artist notes.
boundary: No personal year-by-year forecast until longitudinal evidence exists; never infer a guaranteed outcome from age slider position.
acceptance: Every shared scenario retains assumptions and label; artist can reject it without changing the source tattoo plan.

behavior: Lock the existing-tattoo reference, layer proposals with coverage/contrast comparison and allow artist annotations, alternatives and original/retouched views.
boundary: Cover-up feasibility is a professional judgment; preview does not guarantee concealment or require removal.
acceptance: Original evidence remains recoverable; exported plan distinguishes proposed new ink from existing tattoo and retouched-only scenarios.

behavior: Select labeled conventional, white, UV-reactive or specialty-ink display modes, palette/intensity and light conditions; compare on chosen skin references.
boundary: Material behavior and safety are unverified unless supported by a validated library; UV mode is not ordinary-light appearance.
acceptance: Ink/light mode combinations are retained in exports and cannot be mistaken for a measured physical prediction.

behavior: Show reviewed educational healing stages and a planning range with stated inputs, sources and practitioner notes; keep booking separate.
boundary: No diagnosis, treatment recommendation or individualized healing assurance from images.
acceptance: Incomplete/unsupported inputs yield no precise estimate; final display names assumptions and route to professional review.

behavior: Provide Normal, Multiply, Screen, Overlay and tested advanced modes with opacity preview, explanation and reversible per-layer state.
boundary: Artistic blend names do not imply physical ink accuracy; preserve source colors.
acceptance: Saved/reopened and exported reference patches match the chosen blend implementation; white/colored inks do not disappear unexpectedly.

behavior: Separate fill, stroke and ink palette; provide picker, hex/RGB/alpha, eyedropper, gradients, saved/recent palettes and side-by-side skin preview.
boundary: Out-of-gamut or uncalibrated print/display differences remain visible; no automatic recoloring without preview.
acceptance: Typing a color, using a swatch and sampling converge on identical stored values and undo behavior.

behavior: Name revisions, preview differences, branch alternatives, compare body scenarios and restore a copy; annotate why decisions changed.
boundary: Restoring does not rewrite prior approvals, payments or other users' work.
acceptance: Restored document matches its selected revision and dependent approvals clearly refer to the older version.

behavior: Drag from asset tray or move selection; show resize/rotate/pivot handles plus numeric controls and immediate projection updates. Wheel zooms viewport; modifier behavior is displayed.
boundary: Distinguish viewport zoom from artwork scale; preserve aspect ratio by default and prevent accidental off-canvas loss.
acceptance: Pointer and numeric placement produce the same result; one gesture creates one undo step.

behavior: Pinch zoom/scale, two-finger rotate, pan and tap-to-place with a clear active target; provide touch-size handles and cancel.
boundary: Do not capture page scroll outside stage or silently transform art during two-finger navigation.
acceptance: Gesture changes can be reproduced by accessible controls; interrupted touches leave valid geometry.

behavior: Provide searchable/remappable action shortcuts, arrow nudges, shift increments, undo/redo, selection and command search.
boundary: Text-entry fields keep normal typing shortcuts; shortcuts must not trap focus.
acceptance: Keyboard-only user selects, transforms, orders layers, saves and exports without pointer dependence.

behavior: Offer device-orientation camera orbit or sensor-supported perspective only after permission; include recenter, sensitivity and off switch.
boundary: Sensor motion is not proof of body tracking and may be unavailable.
acceptance: Permission denial preserves ordinary touch controls; orientation drift can be reset without moving artwork.

behavior: Activate push-to-talk, show transcript and recognized action/target; adjust numeric or named properties with undo and optional confirmations.
boundary: Never leave mic on implicitly; ambiguous, destructive or financial instructions require explicit review.
acceptance: Misheard target is corrected before application; canceled command changes nothing and no recording persists without permission.

behavior: Dictate into the editable design brief, choose style/placement constraints, review recognized text, generate alternatives and insert one as a new asset.
boundary: Voice input does not bypass rights, cost disclosure or generation consent.
acceptance: Dictation errors can be corrected before charging; selected result retains prompt and source provenance.

behavior: One account switches among up to one client, one artist and one studio profile; show active context on uploads, messages, orders and settings.
boundary: Authentication identity differs from organization membership and paid plan; prevent creation of a fourth role profile.
acceptance: Switching role never grants private-project access or changes an order's recorded legal/economic party.

behavior: Set private, named participants, restricted link or public per project/asset; choose view/comment/edit/download and revoke access.
boundary: Default body media private; permission inheritance and derived export rights explicit.
acceptance: A viewer cannot edit/export without permission, expired links fail, and public portfolio does not reveal private capture metadata.

behavior: Local recoverable drafts, optional synchronized backups, version restore and portable export; show timestamp, scope and storage state.
boundary: Moving this from Native-only to cross-platform is a recommendation; restoration of encrypted messages requires a separate key plan.
acceptance: Recover a known revision after crash/deletion; partial restore reports missing assets instead of claiming success.

behavior: Folders, collections, tags, search, favorites, recent files, archive and trash with restore; support multi-select move and stable references.
boundary: Moving an asset does not break projects that reference it or transfer ownership.
acceptance: Rename/move/archive keeps linked placements intact and search permissions correct.

behavior: Accept documented PNG/JPEG/WebP/SVG/PDF exports from Procreate, Fresco and other tools; preview supported layers/fonts/effects and conversion loss.
boundary: Native proprietary formats require an explicit tested importer; do not claim fidelity for unsupported project files.
acceptance: A mixed import reports unsupported features, preserves originals and yields editable supported content with correct alpha.

behavior: Attach optional meaning, milestones, photos and private journal entries to a tattoo/project with per-entry audience and export choices.
boundary: Stories never become public from portfolio sharing or training consent by implication.
acceptance: Export/share includes only selected entries; revoked recipient cannot retrieve later private notes.

behavior: Offer visual comparisons, skip/unsure/multiple choices and a revisable preference profile; show why recommendations match.
boundary: Aesthetic preference is not psychological diagnosis or permanent identity.
acceptance: Changing or deleting answers changes recommendations and removes associated personalization state as specified.

behavior: Let users record skin concerns voluntarily and seek practitioner guidance; any image-assisted analysis needs a defined validated purpose.
boundary: Do not diagnose conditions or infer treatment eligibility from a photo.
acceptance: Unknown or unreliable analysis abstains; sensitive inputs remain separate from public profile and ads.

behavior: Configure studio plans for team/branch management, POD/merchandise, marketing, branding, reports and support; show actual entitlements and effective prices.
boundary: Historical ST1/ST2 names retained; exact benefits/pricing require reconciliation. Plan level cannot override client privacy.
acceptance: Upgrade/downgrade preserves existing contracts and exposes a clear entitlement diff before confirmation.

behavior: Configure selling, scheduling, portfolio analytics, promotion, advanced exports and support by artist plan; show fee breakdown per offer.
boundary: Historical 75% vs 90% artist shares are unresolved commercial terms, not silently adopted rates.
acceptance: A plan change affects future quotes only; accepted split and payout records remain unchanged.

behavior: Display free and paid client benefits, compute credits, avatar/simulation access, discounts and storage/export limits before purchase.
boundary: S3 also lists Basic/Premium/Elite; preserve that alternative. Recommend recovery drafts for all, explicitly challenging no-save history.
acceptance: Exhausted entitlement explains alternatives and preserves work; a downgrade does not destroy prior files.

behavior: Preserve requested ST2 affiliation-rule capability as versioned terms displayed before artist acceptance, with duration/scope and exit/dispute record.
boundary: Do not implement automatic cross-studio work bans without jurisdiction/provider review; this is a business/legal gate.
acceptance: No rule can silently alter already accepted work; affected artist sees applicable policy source and an appeal/contact route.

behavior: Invite artists from different organizations to a project, assign scoped roles, contribution/license terms and allocation of proceeds.
boundary: Each studio controls only its scoped membership/offering; cross-organization private data stays isolated.
acceptance: Collaborators can edit agreed art and review allocation without reading another studio's unrelated client records.

behavior: Manage organizations, branches, staff roles, offer templates, commissions, revisions, deposits and cancellation policies with effective dates.
boundary: Resolve platform obligations, accepted agreement and organization policy explicitly; no retroactive policy change.
acceptance: Checkout and booking reproduce the exact accepted policy version after subsequent studio edits.

behavior: Publish consented panoramic/360-degree images with accessible room descriptions, controls, branch address and booking link.
boundary: Never imply current sanitation/credentials from a tour; remove private people or sensitive areas.
acceptance: Tour loads progressively, works without motion controls and routes to the correct branch's availability.

behavior: Search/filter by style, artist, placement, dimensions, palette, license, price, availability and mature-content preference; open reusable preview into workspace.
boundary: Distinguish sponsored results, sold/exclusive designs and algorithmic suggestions.
acceptance: Combining filters yields accurate available licenses; opening preview retains attribution and correct download restrictions.

behavior: Public portfolio with organized work, healed/fresh labels, styles, location, services, rates, availability and verified-credential scope; manage media and privacy.
boundary: Verification badges name what was checked; sample work ownership and client consent required.
acceptance: A client finds relevant work and starts brief/booking; hidden or revoked media disappears from public access.

behavior: Brief→proposal→quote with scope, price/currency, rights, milestones, included revisions and dates; negotiate changes as versioned offers.
boundary: Accepting new terms requires both relevant parties; revision requests do not automatically change price.
acceptance: Approved offer becomes an immutable agreement; declined/replaced proposals cannot initiate the wrong charge.

behavior: Recommend designs/artists using explicit preferences and optional interactions; explain signals, reset preferences, mark seasonal/promoted content.
boundary: No sensitive-body/health data used for targeting by default; cold start has manual filters.
acceptance: Reset removes personalized ranking state; unavailable/blocked designs never reappear through recommendations.

behavior: Save designs, artists and collections with notes, availability alerts and optional shared lists.
boundary: Saving does not reserve an exclusive license or permission to reproduce it.
acceptance: Sold/deleted design stays visibly unavailable in a list without broken links or false purchase availability.

behavior: Schedule a release, display edition inventory, eligibility/time-zone and purchase limit, reserve briefly at checkout and issue a license record.
boundary: Define what exclusivity covers; prevent bots/duplicate allocation and disclose reservation expiry.
acceptance: Simultaneous purchases cannot allocate the same exclusive/numbered entitlement twice.

behavior: Define eligible listing/license, opening/reserve terms, bid increments, end-time and anti-sniping policy; show bid/settlement history.
boundary: Jurisdiction/provider eligibility and bidder obligations gate launch; failed settlement has a documented fallback.
acceptance: Concurrent/end-boundary bids produce a deterministic winner; refunds and seller payout reconcile to the winning agreement.

behavior: Arrange motifs across physical artboards with labels, margins and prices/licenses, then export print/PDF or publish individual/bundle listings.
boundary: A sheet can reference differently licensed designs; publishing requires each license to allow it.
acceptance: Reordering sheet items preserves independent asset IDs and sale availability; print scale and attribution are correct.

behavior: Offer readable license choices with rights to edit, apply to skin, print/POD, resell, promote and train separated; attach exact terms to purchase and derivatives.
boundary: Copyright ownership and usage permission are distinct; commissioning does not silently transfer all rights.
acceptance: Export/POD checks the relevant permitted use and records the accepted license version in the manifest.

behavior: Preview watermarks, attribution, access controls, license receipts, provenance, reporting and a documented takedown/dispute workflow.
boundary: Watermarking is deterrence, not absolute protection; never strip attribution from an export requiring it.
acceptance: Removing a listing preserves existing valid license receipts; unauthorized original download is denied and audited.

behavior: Show supplier-verified temporary-tattoo materials, finish, wear guidance, supported colors, skin-use instructions, cost and production constraints.
boundary: Historical Standard 1–3, Premium 3–7 and Waterproof 5–10 days are unverified supplier claims until validated; preserve them as candidate categories.
acceptance: Out-of-stock/unsupported materials cannot be ordered; checkout snapshots the selected supplier specifications and artwork revision.

behavior: Quote standard/express/international shipping with destination, tracking, taxes/duties assumptions and dispatch/delivery estimates.
boundary: Delivery estimate is not a guarantee; partial shipments, lost parcels and unsupported destinations are explicit states.
acceptance: Address/rate changes recalculate before charge; tracking updates the correct fulfillment item and exception workflow.

behavior: Calculate member pricing, quantity/bundles and promotional codes with eligibility, expiry, stacking rules and full subtotal breakdown.
boundary: Discounts cannot silently change artist royalty basis; define rounding and refund allocation.
acceptance: Same cart/rules yield deterministic totals; expired/ineligible codes explain failure and partial refunds reverse the correct discount allocation.

behavior: Attach artist/studio/platform royalty schedule to licensed POD or design sale, show amount/basis at checkout and accrue on eligible fulfillment.
boundary: Distinguish royalty, commission fee and payout; returns and license cancellations follow snapshot rules.
acceptance: One fulfilled order creates one allocation; a reprint or duplicate webhook cannot pay twice.

behavior: Buy a monetary voucher, usage-credit gift, design entitlement or POD delivery as distinct gift types; choose recipient message, scheduling and redemption.
boundary: Currency, expiration, transferability, geography and unused-balance rules are explicit; never reveal a recipient's private body data.
acceptance: Duplicate redemption fails safely; refunded original purchase has deterministic effect on remaining entitlement.

behavior: Configure studio hours, branch/artist availability, service duration, buffers, time zones and exceptions; request or reserve a consultation/session.
boundary: Travel, overlapping calendars, DST, deposit windows and multi-session work must be handled.
acceptance: Concurrent clients cannot double-book; a DST transition displays correct local time and reminders reference the accepted appointment.

behavior: Export the Go-time package in main §14: brief, art, stencil, coordinates, dimensions, calibration, approvals, rights, revision manifest and selected notes.
boundary: Health data/messages excluded by default; raster-in-SVG is not true vector output; preserve unresolved-fit notes.
acceptance: Recipient can identify exact revision, print measured ruler and distinguish source artwork, placement preview and unresolved assumptions.

behavior: Eligible members submit verified-interaction ratings with category, text and optional consented media; support artist reply/report/appeal.
boundary: Membership-only review policy retained; payment dispute and rating moderation remain distinct.
acceptance: Nonmembers cannot submit if that rule is retained; deleted/flagged content follows visible moderation status without changing commerce records.

behavior: Quote deposit amount/percentage, due date, refundability and balance schedule; collect via supported provider and show paid/pending/failed state.
boundary: Authorization, capture and transfer are distinct; deposits are not cash held by an unimplemented escrow service.
acceptance: Retried deposit action cannot double-charge; expiry releases booking according to accepted policy and reconciles money.

behavior: Present no-show/late-cancel/refund rules before acceptance; record request, eligible amount, review and provider execution.
boundary: Organization terms do not silently override applicable platform/transaction obligations; partial fulfilled items need separate disposition.
acceptance: Refund shown complete only after provider evidence; old orders retain their accepted policy despite later edits.

behavior: Let client specify acceptable dates/services and contact choices; offer canceled slot to eligible waitlist entries with hold expiry and opt-out.
boundary: Do not book or charge without the specified authorization; avoid multiple accepted offers for one slot.
acceptance: Two recipients accepting concurrently result in one valid booking and a clear alternative for the other.

behavior: Record design-operation playback or canvas frames with pause, private-layer exclusion, playback speed and export consent.
boundary: Body captures, messages and off-canvas content are excluded unless explicitly included.
acceptance: Replay reproduces intended creation sequence without revealing hidden private assets or transient notifications.

behavior: Structured, editable brief for references, meaning, placement, scale, color, budget, dates, constraints and multiple/unsure answers; reusable studio templates.
boundary: Required fields are purpose-specific; health information lives in a separately permissioned form.
acceptance: Client can submit an incomplete creative idea with explicit unknowns; artist sees references and missing decisions without invented answers.

behavior: Versioned practice-specific questionnaires, consent/release signing, signer identity, timestamps and restricted staff access; export a signed copy to authorized parties.
boundary: Forms do not replace professional assessment; data-retention and legally valid signature requirements need jurisdiction-specific review.
acceptance: Changed form requires a new signature; public sharing/ordinary design export cannot include responses accidentally.

behavior: Submit consented portfolio subset, remove identity metadata, collect structured critique and reveal identity only by choice.
boundary: Anonymity may be imperfect if art is recognizable; reviewer conflict/report mechanisms required.
acceptance: Downloaded review pack omits identifying metadata and hidden client material; reviewer can decline a conflict.

behavior: Shared references, drawing, annotations and live cursors in the same project; object-level operations with roles, version history and conflict handling.
boundary: Observer/commenter/editor roles differ; offline conflicts and simultaneous edits never silently overwrite.
acceptance: Two editors change separate objects, reconnect and converge; read-only guest cannot mutate document via UI or direct request.

behavior: Persistent project/order-linked threads with unread state, attachments, delivery status and reference to design revision; configurable notifications.
boundary: Message send failure retains a draft; orders and chat history are distinct records.
acceptance: Opening a revision comment goes to its original revision; retry does not create duplicate messages.

behavior: Add live delivery, presence and optional typing/read indicators to the same threads, with offline catch-up and notification controls.
boundary: Recommend capability-based web/mobile support instead of Native-only gate; presence is best-effort, not proof of availability.
acceptance: Disconnect/reconnect delivers each message once in stable order and preserves privacy settings.

behavior: Attach images/files/preview references with progress, cancellation, malware/type validation, size limits and participant-scoped access.
boundary: Full-resolution body photos require separate audience awareness; thumbnail must not bypass permissions.
acceptance: Removed participant cannot fetch attachment URL; failed upload leaves recoverable local file and no falsely sent message.

behavior: Personal/studio replies with named variables, preview and editable content for quotes, aftercare, reminders and common answers.
boundary: Never auto-send AI/template content or financial promises without configured authorization.
acceptance: Missing variables block send or remain clearly marked; recipient/context preview prevents wrong-client messages.

behavior: Show aggregated typical response range and last-updated context; allow away status and office hours.
boundary: Do not expose exact personal activity or guarantee a response deadline from an average.
acceptance: Insufficient history shows unavailable rather than invented hours; paused profiles show the correct status.

behavior: Define endpoint keys, participant changes, encrypted attachments, local storage, device transfer, recovery and authorized reporting in a reviewed threat model.
boundary: Server AI/search cannot read E2EE content without a separate consented design; key loss behavior must be explicit.
acceptance: Server-side storage cannot decrypt a test thread; removed members lack new keys; recovery works only under the declared policy.

behavior: Opt-in peer matching by broad timing/interests, private group conversation, boundaries, blocking and reviewed educational links.
boundary: No automatic health-data sharing or peer diagnosis; users can participate without revealing body images/location.
acceptance: Opt-out removes future matching; block stops interaction; health questions route to professional-care resources rather than model diagnosis.

behavior: Define supported client/artist/studio/platform transfers plus requested user-to-user and collaborator payments; present purpose, sender/recipient, fees, status and receipt.
boundary: General P2P and cross-border rails require explicit provider eligibility; internal credits are not a cash wallet.
acceptance: Each enabled route has tested debit/credit, rejection, reversal and statement reconciliation; unsupported routes stay clearly unavailable.

behavior: Calculate versioned platform, studio and artist allocations per accepted offer with amount basis, currency, tax/processing-fee responsibility and rounding.
boundary: Changes to membership do not alter accepted allocation; percentages alone are insufficient without defining gross/net basis.
acceptance: Minor-unit allocations balance for ordinary, discounted, partial-refund and FX cases; duplicate events do not duplicate earnings.

behavior: Preserve secure milestone payment intent; offer provider-supported holding/release with explicit conditions, duration, dispute route and beneficiary.
boundary: Do not call delayed payout escrow unless actual qualified arrangement exists; no product promise of indefinite custody.
acceptance: Gate includes provider contract and end-to-end held/released/refunded/expired states; absent support shows an honest alternative.

behavior: Present total price, installment amounts/dates, fees/interest if any, failure handling and consent; separate payment schedule from lending offer.
boundary: Regional/provider eligibility required; do not create unqualified credit underwriting.
acceptance: Failed installment updates balance and appointment policy without duplicate fees or unintended artist payout.

behavior: Show eligible standard/instant payout options, fees, estimated arrival and linked account verification; track pending/paid/failed/returned states.
boundary: Historical 3–5 day schedule is not universally promised; availability/currency depend on provider.
acceptance: Failed/returned payout reconciles balance; selecting instant exposes fee before confirmation.

behavior: Statements summarize gross sales, fees, refunds, taxes, allocations and payouts by period; eligible provider-generated tax forms appear with corrections.
boundary: Tax-form obligations depend on jurisdiction/party; do not imply ARTOO determines every person's filing duty.
acceptance: Statement totals reconcile to ledger and provider events; corrected records produce a versioned statement rather than silent overwrite.

behavior: Show presentment/settlement currencies, quoted rate/time, conversion fee and expiry before acceptance.
boundary: No silent currency mixing; refunds may differ due to FX and must disclose policy.
acceptance: Currency exponents and rounding remain correct; an expired rate triggers review before payment.

behavior: Retain card, PayPal, Venmo, Cash App, Google Pay, Revolut, Stripe-supported methods, Apple Pay and crypto in the capability matrix; display only eligible routes.
boundary: None is assumed universally available or free; crypto is separately gated and not required for normal checkout.
acceptance: Unsupported device/region never yields a dead payment button; accepted methods have tested failure/refund/receipt paths.

behavior: Earn/redeem defined points or discounts for eligible repeat activity; show balance, expiry, rules and reversal effects.
boundary: Loyalty units differ from cash and generation credits; refunded activity cannot silently retain unearned value.
acceptance: Accrual/reversal/redemption is idempotent and presents the correct discount in a multi-seller cart.

behavior: Create beneficiary-linked event, eligible designs, allocation percentage/basis, schedule and public accounting summary with artist consent.
boundary: Beneficiary verification and payment eligibility required; distinguish donation from artist revenue and fees.
acceptance: Final report reconciles proceeds and transfers; cancellation/refund updates beneficiary allocation transparently.

behavior: Central entitlement catalogue powers pricing, tool availability, quota messages and account settings; show upgrade/downgrade effective date and billing terms.
boundary: Do not hide unsupported features behind payment; permission, plan and hardware availability are separate reasons.
acceptance: Identical entitlement policy governs UI, export, API and background jobs; cancellation preserves documented access until effective expiry.

behavior: Retain historical cohort proposal as an explicit campaign with eligibility counter, benefit duration, included plan, abuse controls and receipt.
boundary: Current approval and economics unresolved; cannot imply perpetual free access or discount without terms.
acceptance: Concurrent signups allocate the last cohort slot once; users see the benefit duration and post-promotion price before accepting.

behavior: Meter named expensive actions with per-action cost, remaining/renewal/rollover, reservations, completed charges and failure refunds; optional one-time top-ups.
boundary: Historical 8/day versus 2/day/20/day quotas conflict; ordinary editing and failed jobs should not silently consume credits.
acceptance: Job retry, cancellation and provider failure reconcile reserved/consumed credits exactly once.

behavior: Permit eligible design licenses, POD, services or credit packs without a subscription; present rights, total and guest/account recovery route.
boundary: Product availability depends on studio/artist offer; gift/return rules vary by item type.
acceptance: Non-subscriber can complete an eligible POD purchase and recover receipt/order without gaining unrelated premium access.

behavior: Partner dashboard manages agreed campaigns, featured artists, brand placements, asset approvals, dates, attribution and revenue share with performance reports.
boundary: Label paid placement; do not let sponsorship change quality badges or expose private client activity.
acceptance: Expired campaign stops placement; organic and paid metrics are separated and allocated revenue reconciles.

behavior: Curated, attributed histories with sources, community/practitioner contributions, dates, region context and optional multimedia/oral-history records.
boundary: Consent and cultural stewardship govern publication; uncertain or contested accounts are labeled.
acceptance: Reader can inspect provenance/corrections; restricted traditional knowledge is not republished through automatic recommendations.

behavior: Explore styles, events and contributing artists by region; optionally show aggregated popularity with sample period and minimum aggregation threshold.
boundary: Popularity is not cultural origin; private client coordinates never appear as points.
acceptance: Sparse data yields no heat claim; map has accessible list alternative and every geography links to source/context.

behavior: Browse a style taxonomy with examples, related techniques and artists who self-identify/are reviewed for it; combine location/license filters.
boundary: Styles overlap; support multi-label/uncertain classifications and cultural context.
acceptance: User can follow a style and find suitable artists without forced single-style assignment.

behavior: Upload a permissioned reference to retrieve similar styles/designs/artists with scores and explanations, plus manual taxonomy refinement.
boundary: Similarity does not prove authorship or identify a person; images stay private unless shared.
acceptance: Known/unknown-style test set includes abstention; no result asserts a specific tattoo creator without supporting provenance.

behavior: Contributor profiles, reviewed lessons and assessment tracks with issuer, prerequisites, learning objectives and completion records.
boundary: A course completion badge is not automatically professional licensure or accreditation.
acceptance: Issued credential states exactly who certifies what and supports correction/revocation.

behavior: Publish sessions with timezone, accessibility features, registration, reminders, participation and consented replay/transcript.
boundary: External attendance/video providers need scoped permission; recording is disclosed.
acceptance: Timezone conversion is correct, keyboard registration works, and replay access follows the purchased/granted entitlement.

behavior: Searchable articles, edits, sources, contributor attribution, moderation and version history for techniques and practical guidance.
boundary: Separate professional advice, personal experience and unverified claims; no automatic acceptance of medical claims.
acceptance: A corrected article shows revision/source and reported content can be reviewed without losing prior record.

behavior: List conventions, guest spots, flash events and studio sessions with dates, venues, accessibility info and interested/follow actions.
boundary: Dates are source-linked and refreshable; a listed event is not a booked appointment.
acceptance: Canceled/rescheduled event propagates to subscribers and linked listings without changing paid bookings silently.

behavior: Multi-item/multi-seller cart supports optional preview in workspace, quantities/licenses, split fulfillment and full price summary.
boundary: Cart preview does not grant export rights; exclusive inventory can expire.
acceptance: Mixed digital/POD/service items retain correct taxes, rights and separate fulfillment states; preview edits do not change purchased artwork without confirmation.

behavior: Restore signed-in cart across sessions/devices with visible unavailable items and expiry policy; retain historical 48-hour rule as configurable proposal.
boundary: Restored cart reprices and revalidates inventory, shipping, discounts and licenses before checkout.
acceptance: Returning after price/license change requires explicit review and never charges the stale total.

behavior: Timeline of quote, deposit, draft, revision, approval, delivery, balance, payout and exceptions; each status identifies actor and timestamp.
boundary: Status transitions require actual evidence; an assistant-generated message cannot mark payment complete.
acceptance: Client/artist see the same accepted revision and can inspect reason for delay/dispute.

behavior: Artist sets a date or range from workload/milestones, updates with reason and notifies affected participants.
boundary: Forecast is not guaranteed; no invented estimate when availability is unknown.
acceptance: Changed estimate preserves earlier promise/history and distinguishes blocked inputs from artist work time.

behavior: Request changes against a specific revision, categorize included/out-of-scope, annotate objects/regions and accept a versioned change order if needed.
boundary: Unlimited revisions are not inferred; new cost needs acceptance before charging.
acceptance: Requests cannot silently modify approved art or consume allowance twice on retry.

behavior: Topic spaces, search, threads, media permissions, subscriptions, reporting, blocks and moderator actions with appeals.
boundary: Separate public discussion from private project messages; mature preferences apply.
acceptance: A private attachment cannot be posted by URL leakage; moderation status is clear and accessible.

behavior: Invite chosen reviewers/community to comment on a revision with criteria such as composition/readability/placement and a choice of anonymous/public feedback.
boundary: Comments are suggestions; applying one creates an editable change and preserves authorship/rights.
acceptance: Review resolution records which revision changed; a new revision does not pretend earlier reviewers approved it.

behavior: Mentor/apprentice profiles, goals, availability, eligibility, applications, agreed program and progress record; optional fees use supported commerce.
boundary: Qualifications, safeguarding and employment/training terms need review; platform match is not credential endorsement.
acceptance: Applicant controls shared information and can withdraw; acceptance creates explicit terms rather than silent account access.

behavior: Publish brief, rules, rights, judging criteria, dates, prize/funding and submission workflow with results/appeals.
boundary: Entry does not silently assign all copyright or training permission; eligibility/payment law gate where applicable.
acceptance: Late/duplicate entries are handled consistently and judges see only authorized material under declared anonymity rules.

behavior: Schedule featured-artist periods with editorial assets, availability, events, commercial terms and disclosure.
boundary: Promotion does not imply verified superiority; end-date and cancellation visible.
acceptance: Residency expires automatically and linked booking/artist pages stay valid.

behavior: Swipe or use accessible buttons to save, skip, dislike or request similar designs; give preference reset and exploration controls.
boundary: Working title only; avoid making compulsive engagement the success metric or hiding creator/rights information.
acceptance: Disliked designs respect preferences; keyboard/buttons provide equivalent actions and saved art opens correctly in workspace.

behavior: Combine artist/guest availability, travel destination references, consultation preparation and event information with links to current sources.
boundary: No invented travel/legal/medical guarantees; booking and travel purchases are distinct.
acceptance: Guide flags stale dates and routes to the actual studio branch and current booking availability.

behavior: Publish a brief to eligible artists, define compensation, confidentiality, selection criteria, submission rights and proposal comparison.
boundary: Unselected proposals remain the creator's property unless explicit agreed terms say otherwise.
acceptance: Client cannot export/use unlicensed losing proposals; selected work becomes a normal commission agreement.

behavior: Explore attributed influence relationships with direction, source, date and disputed/uncertain status; allow corrections and artist participation.
boundary: Similar appearance is not proof of influence or lineage.
acceptance: Every asserted connection has a source/status; removing an unsupported link does not erase unrelated contributors.

behavior: Versioned extension registry with declared capabilities, scopes, compatible document schema, UI placement, installation/disable/update and owner review.
boundary: Extensions cannot read private projects/payment data by default or corrupt documents; isolate execution and preserve export portability.
acceptance: Disabled/crashing plugin leaves project openable; permission denial is enforced outside its UI and unsupported data is retained safely.

behavior: Scoped connectors for external booking, calendars and studio CRM with field mapping, ownership/source-of-truth, consent, retry and sync history.
boundary: Handle revoked tokens, rate limits, timezones, conflict and duplicate events; do not import health fields by default.
acceptance: Replayed webhook yields one appointment/client update; conflict presents both values rather than silently overwriting.

behavior: Let artists save validated actions for transforms, naming, batch export and visualization rules; preview affected objects and run with limits.
boundary: Sandbox with no default network/secrets/payment access; command transactions enable rollback.
acceptance: A script that exceeds time/memory stops without partial corrupt state; user can undo the full accepted change.

behavior: Install licensed brushes, templates, palettes, textures and example presets with preview, provenance, compatibility and updates.
boundary: A style pack grants only listed rights; dependency fonts/assets and versions remain tracked.
acceptance: Uninstall leaves existing work reproducible or reports missing dependencies with embedded/permitted fallback.

behavior: Light/dark/high-contrast plus custom tokens and density; preview before apply, reset and retain per-device preference.
boundary: Interface theme never changes white artboard, print background or actual artwork color.
acceptance: Theme switch preserves source art and contrast/focus checks; invalid custom contrast produces a useful warning.

behavior: Externalized strings, locale-aware numbers/currency/dates, RTL layouts, font shaping and translation review; choose language independent of location.
boundary: User text is not automatically translated; names/licenses retain exact approved wording.
acceptance: Arabic/long-text/large-font fixtures fit panels and exports without clipped or reversed art labels.

behavior: Private artist/studio dashboards for inquiries, accepted briefs, sales, fulfillment, fees and repeat usage with time range and consented event definitions.
boundary: Separate organic/paid and previews/successful outcomes; exclude body media, message contents and health data from events.
acceptance: Dashboard totals reconcile to orders/ledger and respect organization/branch access; low sample size is visible.

behavior: Export permissioned previews to Facebook, Instagram, Pinterest and eligible networks; choose crop/caption/attribution/audience and preview before publish.
boundary: Platform APIs may limit direct posting; offer downloadable/share-sheet fallback and never auto-publish private body imagery.
acceptance: Revoked connector retains draft; exported image has intended attribution and no hidden private metadata.

behavior: Calibrate camera/display/projector to region, select client-approved placement, provide operator controls, alignment cues and safe session reset.
boundary: Device integration and accuracy/safety proof required; not automatically equivalent to a stencil or autonomous tattooing guide.
acceptance: Calibration drift is detected and display stops presenting precision until corrected; ending consultation clears private media.

behavior: Optional labeled concept rendering with references and professional consultation notes, using the shared placement/scenario system.
boundary: No procedural instruction or prediction of scarring outcome; release requires practitioner review and appropriate context.
acceptance: Preview cannot be exported as a validated expected result and never replaces original body imagery.

behavior: Compare design in user-selected beach, office or formal-event context, retaining body/placement revision and changed lighting/clothing assumptions.
boundary: Generated environments may change appearance; do not present them as observed photos or geometrically calibrated references.
acceptance: Scenario metadata identifies generated content and the original placement remains available for exact export.

behavior: Optional music/mood pairing with volume, mute, licensing/source and individual preference; never start audio without choice.
boundary: Music is atmospheric, not evidence of design suitability; accessible silent workflow remains complete.
acceptance: Muting persists; exports omit audio unless licensed and selected.

behavior: Voluntary session plans, breaks, timer, comfort notes and practitioner-agreed milestones; pause/resume and accessible reminders.
boundary: No health or pain-tolerance score, and no pressure to continue a session.
acceptance: Pausing updates planned duration without automatically charging or sharing sensitive notes.

behavior: Keyboard and numeric editing, object list, readable labels, high contrast, reduced motion, captions, text size, voice option and visual brief choices.
boundary: Canvas exceptions are documented narrowly; absence of pointer/voice capability must not block ordinary project completion.
acceptance: Complete the core journey with keyboard and assistive technology; publish observed failures instead of a compliance claim without audit.

behavior: Offer opt-in, source-attributed cultural/context notes for motifs, terminology and restricted traditions; allow expert review and correction.
boundary: Not an automated universal approval/rejection of culture; avoid conflating style similarity with cultural provenance.
acceptance: Uncertain motif returns uncertainty and references; user can inspect and contest a flag without an unexplained content ban.

behavior: Identify text/script, offer translation/transliteration candidates, literal meaning, typography direction and native-speaker review request before freezing.
boundary: Translation is high-consequence in permanent art; no guaranteed correctness or single forced answer.
acceptance: Approved wording is locked to revision; mirrored/changed glyphs trigger re-review and handoff includes original and translated text.

behavior: Gather user references, palette, style choices and optional generated suggestions into an editable board with labels, source links and license notes.
boundary: Generated references do not become licensed final art automatically; user can mix, remove or replace every suggestion.
acceptance: Reordering/changing palette is reversible; importing a board into a project preserves citations and private-source restrictions.

behavior: Practitioner-scoped timeline of briefs, approvals, sessions, consented photos, orders and follow-ups; filter by branch/project and export subset.
boundary: Historical health records remain in restricted domain; affiliation change does not expose all clients to a new organization.
acceptance: A staff role sees only permitted clients/fields and a deleted photo is not re-exposed through timeline thumbnails.

behavior: Estimate supplies from artist-entered coverage, palette, technique, sessions and configurable usage assumptions; output a range with editable quantities.
boundary: No universal ink-consumption formula; artist validates and no procurement occurs automatically.
acceptance: Changing technique assumptions changes the visible estimate; missing inputs remain unknown and can be manually entered.

behavior: Compare consented portfolio periods by self-chosen tags, techniques and compositions; show examples and editable observations.
boundary: Inference is not a ranking of artistic worth; no unauthorized artist-style training.
acceptance: Removing a portfolio item removes it from future analysis and observations link back to supporting examples.

behavior: Forecast from booked/quoted work, conversion assumptions, cancellations, fees and payout timing; show scenarios and realized versus forecast totals.
boundary: A booked amount is not cash received; forecast is not a guarantee or tax advice.
acceptance: Canceling a booking changes future forecast only; historical realized earnings reconcile to ledger.

behavior: Context-aware help proposes document edits, brief summaries, admin drafts and suggested scheduling/actions; show scope, before/after and undo.
boundary: It cannot autonomously send messages, publish, sign, charge or change rights without the configured user's authorization.
acceptance: Prompt involving an unselected/private object cannot access it; accepted edit is one undoable transaction and rejected proposal changes nothing.

behavior: Create funded guest-artist/travel proposal with goal, eligible contributors, deadline, benefit, allocation and failure/refund terms.
boundary: Payment/fundraising eligibility and fulfillment risk need a supported route; no informal untracked custody.
acceptance: Unmet goal returns or retains money only under accepted terms and all contributions reconcile.

behavior: Sell a bounded short consultation, historically suggested as 15 minutes, with deliverable, availability, fee and no-show rules.
boundary: Duration is an offer attribute, not universal promise; design/IP rights remain explicit.
acceptance: Purchased slot links to deliverable and receipt; extending session requires a new accepted charge.

behavior: Optional token-linked authenticity/collectibility flow references off-chain license, artist identity, artwork hash and transaction record.
boundary: NFT ownership does not itself transfer copyright; chain/provider/cost and recovery choices unresolved.
acceptance: Standard non-token license remains usable; token transfer cannot silently change design rights or reveal private source art.

behavior: Long-term opt-in preservation with portable formats, checksums, retention promise, restore checks and successor/closure export route.
boundary: Do not promise perpetual storage without funded operational terms; encrypted content requires key recovery plan.
acceptance: Restore a sampled archived project and verify assets/checksums; service closure plan yields a usable export.

behavior: Artist offers periodic flash access with release cadence, available catalog, renewal terms and rights during/after subscription.
boundary: Viewing access and permanent usage licenses differ; cancellation must explain which acquired rights survive.
acceptance: Canceled member can retrieve surviving licenses but cannot acquire newly released paid content without entitlement.

behavior: Optional per-order environmental estimate and offset purchase with source, method, date, uncertainty and provider receipt.
boundary: Avoid unsupported precise footprint or carbon-neutral claims; no mandatory added charge.
acceptance: User can decline without changing art/order function; receipt separates estimate from actual offset transaction.

behavior: Optional supported-device feedback for tool/selection actions or clearly labeled sensory demo with strength/mute controls.
boundary: A phone vibration does not simulate real tattoo pain faithfully; do not claim validated pain preview.
acceptance: Reduced-motion/sensory preference disables feedback; unsupported hardware leaves controls functional.

behavior: Connect users to eligible professionals or reviewed educational guidance, with consented sharing of specified media and appointment workflow.
boundary: AI-assisted triage or prediction requires separate defined purpose, validation and applicable review; no unvalidated diagnosis from image.
acceptance: User selects each shared item and recipient; unavailable professional service is not replaced by a confident AI diagnosis.

behavior: Source-attributed pigment/material articles with dates, jurisdiction context, uncertainty and practitioner-reviewed updates.
boundary: Educational content is not individualized safety clearance or endorsement of an unverified ink product.
acceptance: Product/ingredient claims link to current sources; outdated content is marked for review and corrected visibly.

behavior: Demonstrate conceptual smart/interactive tattoo behavior through optional overlays, with compatible device/partner requirements and illustrative labels.
boundary: Physical availability, biocompatibility and interoperability are not inferred from a digital demo.
acceptance: Demo functions without pretending a user owns compatible hardware; exports distinguish speculative elements from ordinary art.

behavior: Template-assisted lettering/layout for user-supplied, clinician-reviewed alert information; privacy controls, exact wording approval and print review.
boundary: No diagnosis or assumption of universal emergency recognition; never generate medical facts about the user.
acceptance: Final export matches approved wording exactly and changes invalidate review; private diagnosis data is not public by default.

behavior: Opt-in compatible diffuser pairing, scent selection, intensity/duration, disconnect and immediate stop; store no health assumptions.
boundary: Hardware/availability/sensitivity and safety review required; never default on or claim therapeutic benefit.
acceptance: Stop/disconnect halts output reliably; the complete design workflow works with no diffuser.

behavior: Define data inventory/purpose, access/export/deletion requests, consent records, retention, processor controls and auditability by region.
boundary: Compliance is an assessed operating obligation, not a UI toggle; lawful record retention and media deletion can differ.
acceptance: Data-subject export/deletion tests cover originals, derived images, cached links and training-consent records with documented exceptions.

behavior: Verify artist/studio identity through a suitable provider/process; display badge scope, status, expiry and appeal/recheck route.
boundary: Identity is not proof of artistic skill or medical/professional licensing; do not expose verification documents publicly.
acceptance: Pending/failed/expired checks cannot show verified status; restricted documents remain inaccessible to ordinary studio staff.

domain: AI creation and modern editing contracts
behavior: Editable prompt/reference/placement brief, styles, palette and constraints produce preview alternatives; refine a selected region, compare and insert approved output as a new asset/version.
boundary: Disclose cost/provider and preserve original; do not flatten a whole project to change one object or call raster layers vectors.
acceptance: Targeted change preserves unrelated objects/text; canceled/failed job does not consume duplicate credits and old revision remains restorable.

domain: AI creation and modern editing contracts
behavior: Creator-approved dataset, permitted purpose/style scope, compensation, model version and revocation terms; preview outputs in a controlled evaluation.
boundary: Similarity matching and training are separate consent scopes; no scraping of artists' portfolios by default.
acceptance: A revoked/expired training license blocks new training and distribution as specified; model/data provenance is inspectable.

domain: AI creation and modern editing contracts
behavior: Pen/pencil, airbrush, tattoo-tip, watercolor and crayon presets expose size, opacity, flow, hardness, spacing, smoothing, pressure/tilt and live stroke samples.
boundary: Simulated tattoo tips are design tools, not tattoo-machine operation instructions; disclose approximated brush behavior.
acceptance: Each named brush produces observably distinct strokes and saves/reopens; size controls also cover eraser and line width.

domain: AI creation and modern editing contracts
behavior: Fonts/search, rich text, effects, weight/style/decoration, tracking/kerning/line height, alignment, curved/path text and editable text-to-outline copy.
boundary: Missing fonts or unsupported scripts are flagged; preserve original text when outlining and licensing metadata when sharing fonts.
acceptance: Non-Latin/RTL/multiline text round-trips and exports; editing a word does not move unrelated design objects.
provenance: Explicit modernization expansion; see main shared-editor contract and current-tech review

domain: AI creation and modern editing contracts
behavior: Click/marquee/lasso, multi-select, duplicate/copy/paste, nested grouping, pivot, numeric transforms, grids/guides/rulers, alignment/distribution and snapping.
boundary: Snap can be bypassed; groups retain child relationships; viewport zoom never changes physical dimensions.
acceptance: Group/ungroup/alignment after rotation and undo reproduce reference geometry without losing object IDs.
provenance: Explicit modernization expansion; see main shared-editor contract and current-tech review

domain: AI creation and modern editing contracts
names: Lines, curves, symmetry and vector nodes
behavior: Freehand, line/polyline/Bézier, pen nodes/handles, join/cap/dashes, path operations, symmetry/mirror and shape primitives under Elements.
boundary: Distinguish vector nodes from raster edge guesses; simplification/trace is previewed as a new editable object.
acceptance: Closed/open paths and mirrored designs round-trip; original reference remains when auto-tracing fails.
provenance: Explicit modernization expansion; see main shared-editor contract and current-tech review

domain: AI creation and modern editing contracts
behavior: Object delete, selected-region flood fill, tolerance/contiguity, freehand alpha erasure, restore brush and nondestructive mask editing.
boundary: Brush erasure must not delete a whole object accidentally; foreground white ink remains selectable separately from background.
acceptance: Erase part of a bitmap, undo, recolor only selected region and export with intended alpha.
provenance: Explicit modernization expansion; see main shared-editor contract and current-tech review

domain: AI creation and modern editing contracts
behavior: Search/reuse licensed vectors, transparent images, frames, shapes and templates; replace selected asset, preserve intended transform and inspect source rights.
boundary: Template availability does not grant all embedded asset rights; malicious SVG/scripts sanitized.
acceptance: Unsupported SVG features are reported and user project cannot execute embedded active content.

domain: AI creation and modern editing contracts
behavior: Named layers, thumbnails, order, groups, masks, visibility/lock, opacity/blend, isolate, duplicate and reversible image corrections.
boundary: Grid/guides are stage overlays, not content; destructive merge requires saved originals or explicit action.
acceptance: Reorder/lock/visibility agrees between stage and inspector; undo and reload retain effects without duplicating objects.
provenance: Explicit modernization expansion; see main shared-editor contract and current-tech review

domain: AI creation and modern editing contracts
behavior: Custom/preset sizes, unit conversion, pages/boards, margins/bleed, resize anchors, selective export, batch variants and print preflight.
boundary: Resizing artboard differs from scaling all content; PDF/PNG/SVG capabilities accurately labeled.
acceptance: Export selected boards in correct order, dimensions and background; no handles or guides included.

domain: AI creation and modern editing contracts
behavior: Unified command history, named versions, autosave local/cloud states, offline edits, conflict branch and crash recovery across all studio modes.
boundary: Source operations, placement operations and financial actions have distinct histories; no blanket undo of sent money.
acceptance: Crash after acknowledged save recovers art; offline conflict exposes alternatives and does not silently overwrite.

domain: AI creation and modern editing contracts
behavior: Reuse all editor categories in body modes; select Edit design versus Adjust placement; inverse-map edits to source and project immediately with optional flat inset.
boundary: Ambiguous folds/occluded targets prompt view change; no forced repeated export/re-import loop.
acceptance: Draw, recolor, text edit, SAM mask and erase on a body preview update editable source without moving placement.

domain: AI creation and modern editing contracts
behavior: Save comparable fit/scale/light/ink/motion/age/rights/output scenarios, run defined checks, compare A–B and annotate a chosen revision.
boundary: Developer tests and user simulations are distinct; physiological predictions remain gated.
acceptance: A scenario report identifies changed variables and assumptions and can be reproduced from the saved revision.

domain: AI creation and modern editing contracts
behavior: Clip timeline with trim/split/reorder, tracks, simple keyframes, captions, narration/licensed audio, timelapse and consultation presentation playback.
boundary: Recorded evidence and generated frames are distinguishable; paid/licensed audio cannot be included without rights.
acceptance: Rendered clip preserves art orientation, timestamps, captions and permissioned audio; failed render keeps timeline editable.
provenance: Explicit modernization expansion; see main shared-editor contract and current-tech review

domain: AI creation and modern editing contracts
names: Whiteboards, briefs and studio brand kits
behavior: Editable mood board, document/consultation deck, studio palette/fonts/templates and approved asset sets share project references and access rules.
boundary: Brand constraints apply only to intended public/studio outputs, never change a client's tattoo colors without consent.
acceptance: One approved artwork revision appears consistently in brief, deck and promo layout; updating it shows pending review.
provenance: Explicit modernization expansion; see main shared-editor contract and current-tech review

domain: AI creation and modern editing contracts
behavior: Structured brief/consent/feedback forms, client/booking/earnings tables, public artist pages, email/social drafts and reusable templates.
boundary: General-purpose spreadsheet/web-builder parity is an expansion decision; sending/publishing requires explicit authorized action.
acceptance: Form response respects field-level privacy and outputs keep source revision/license; draft generation never auto-publishes.
provenance: Explicit modernization expansion; see main shared-editor contract and current-tech review

domain: AI creation and modern editing contracts
behavior: Offer Convert to editable layers; choose target/count, preview RGBA components, inspect recomposition difference and accept a new version.
boundary: Inferred layers can hallucinate occluded content; neither exact recovery of original layers nor true vector reconstruction is promised.
acceptance: Fine lines, text and white ink survive recomposition within agreed error; failure leaves original untouched.
provenance: Explicit modernization expansion; see main shared-editor contract and current-tech review

domain: AI creation and modern editing contracts
behavior: Optional text/voice acts on named selected objects through validated editor commands with before/after diff, cost and one-step undo.
boundary: A new conversational paradigm must not supersede the confirmed direct-manipulation/editor-first experience.
acceptance: 'Recolor this flower' changes only the selected flower; denied scope or ambiguous target yields clarification, not a guessed global edit.

domain: AI creation and modern editing contracts
behavior: Label each body model/preview as observed, calibrated, inferred or generated; retain model/version, scale source, uncertainty and quality flags through handoff.
boundary: A visually convincing generated body is not personal anatomy measurement.
acceptance: An uncalibrated generative preview cannot be exported as a calibrated stencil placement without explicit validated registration.
provenance: Explicit modernization expansion; see main shared-editor contract and current-tech review

behavior: Consistent tools and project semantics across supported desktop/tablet/mobile, adaptive drawers, readable labels, touch and keyboard alternatives.
boundary: Device capability differences are surfaced, not hidden behind broken controls.
acceptance: Supported-device core task suite passes; no clipped properties or missing canvas at documented breakpoints.

behavior: Instrument open-to-edit, input-to-frame, masks/fit, frame rate, drift, battery and thermal behavior using named fixtures and supported devices.
boundary: Three-second goal applies to scoped loading; older universal FPS/accuracy promises are historical, not proven.
acceptance: Publish percentiles and per-condition failures under main §12; mock logs do not satisfy a real-device gate.

behavior: Track repeat artist use, accepted handoffs, paid conversion, contribution margin, refunds/support costs and acquisition cohorts.
boundary: Historical viral/download/revenue figures are unverified aspirations, not forecasts; current budget unknown.
acceptance: A dated dashboard distinguishes actuals, targets and modeled scenarios and never counts failed retries as successful value.

behavior: Model subscriptions, compute credits, design/POD royalties, one-time sales and professional plans against actual costs, usage and willingness to pay.
boundary: Historical tier/credit/fee conflicts remain visible; proposal cannot silently lock prices or remove retained benefits.
acceptance: Sensitivity analysis shows cost per successful task, margin and cancellation/refund effects before a pricing decision.

behavior: Document studio/artist/brand opportunity, specific technical surface, compensation, deliverables and measured campaign impact.
boundary: Partner interest is not a signed agreement; sponsored reach is not organic retention.
acceptance: Each active partnership has accepted scope, asset rights and accountable outcomes tied to consented data.

behavior: Preserve requested 2018–2022 chronology, viral-event, UX, technology, distribution, pricing and transferable-pattern analysis as an explicit research work item.
boundary: Old 19.3M/$30.7M figures and causal claims are not reverified here; do not force the roadmap to mirror a different product.
acceptance: Primary/reputable dated evidence supports each statistic; distinguish correlation/causation and propose a testable ARTOO experiment for any transfer.

names: Adaptive model evaluation and consented learning
behavior: Compare baseline and candidate render/mapping methods using labeled fixtures, optional user corrections, data provenance, evaluation versions, monitored rollout and rollback.
boundary: No automatic training from private captures; synthetic augmentation is labeled and cannot replace diverse real validation.
acceptance: Candidate promotes only after fixed holdout evaluation, per-condition checks, cost/latency limits and tested rollback; consent withdrawal follows declared dataset policy.
provenance: Explicit modernization expansion; see main shared-editor contract and current-tech review

names: About, FAQ, feedback and Easter egg
behavior: Provide accessible product/contact/FAQ, feedback intake and social references; preserve requested secret Easter egg as optional discoverable delight.
boundary: S6 question labels are clipped, so exact hidden content/links are unresolved; no essential function depends on finding it.
acceptance: Main workflows and help work without the Easter egg; feedback has a receipt/status and no unexpected marketing subscription.

behavior: Supported sign-in including requested Google OAuth, session/account recovery and isolated development/test/production data and credentials.
boundary: Auth provider is not assumed selected; demo users cannot access live body media or payments.
acceptance: Test tokens fail in production, sign-out invalidates protected access, and profile switch never changes underlying account identity.

behavior: Curate searchable prompt recipes with style, placement and palette placeholders, examples, author/license notes and editable saved personal variants.
boundary: Recipes suggest concepts without guaranteeing artist imitation or identical results; versions identify provider/model used.
acceptance: User edits a recipe, generates alternatives and can recover the exact submitted prompt without overwriting the shared recipe.

behavior: Map/list nearby artists, shops and guest spots with optional device location or manual city/radius, styles, accessibility, availability and booking links.
boundary: Location permission is optional; private client locations are never published and geocoding failures have list/manual fallback.
acceptance: User with location disabled can find an eligible artist in an entered city and reach the correct branch/service page.

behavior: Opt-in share a chosen workspace view during a call with participant list, visible sharing indicator, stop control and optional co-pointer.
boundary: Screen sharing is separate from edit permission and recording; health forms, messages and unrelated tabs excluded by default.
acceptance: Stopping ends transmission, a viewer cannot edit, and private panels remain hidden in the selected shared surface.

behavior: Define custom project stages, required documents, approval gates, message/contract templates and aftercare checklists; show responsible role and blocking reason.
boundary: Custom labels cannot bypass canonical payment, license or approval states; policy changes apply prospectively.
acceptance: Missing consent blocks only the defined downstream action and an authorized exception is auditable; status does not fabricate payment evidence.

behavior: EXIF orientation, color-profile handling, quality/resolution checks, video-frame extraction, comparable camera views, progressive thumbnails and cached renders retain source originals.
boundary: Compression/upscale cannot silently alter print dimensions or represent generated detail as original; cache keys include revision/render settings.
acceptance: Reopened project resolves original art, correct alpha and frame timestamps; stale thumbnails never replace newly edited content.

behavior: Combine candidate segmentation, landmarks/depth and user correction to isolate visible target skin, with confidence, selected body/side and occlusion boundaries.
boundary: HSV/YCrCb/Canny may help bounded cases but are not universal skin detection; person masks can contain clothes and background.
acceptance: Diverse-tone, hairy, scarred, tattooed and clothed-edge fixtures report mask/fit errors separately; uncertain input prompts correction.
